'''Gregor Hauffe''' (born 20 May 1982 in [[Magdeburg]], [[East Germany]]) is a German former representative rower. He is a three time world champion and a dual Olympian. Hauffe competed at [[2008 Summer Olympics|Beijing 2008]] and [[2012 Summer Olympics|London 2012]] in the men's coxless four with both those crews making the Olympic final.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.olympic.org/olympic-results/beijing-2008/rowing/four-without-coxswain-4-m|title=Beijing 2008 four without coxswain 4 men – Olympic Beijing 2008 Rowing|date=3 June 2017|website=Olympic.org|access-date=29 October 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.olympic.org/olympic-results/london-2012/rowing/four-without-coxswain-4-m|title=London 2012 four without coxswain 4 men – Olympic Rowing|date=3 June 2017|website=Olympic.org|access-date=29 October 2017}}</ref>
